title: Add live HTTP tools-call coverage
summary: Cover `/tools/call` through a real daemon and HTTP gateway by authenticating with the minted operator token, proving the call is denied before `tool.call.echo` is granted, granting the capability over HTTP, and verifying the echo result.
expectedFailureModes: The live HTTP gateway lists tools but cannot execute a real tool call through the daemon.
The HTTP tool-call route bypasses capability checks for the operator token.
The HTTP grant route signs a capability that the subsequent tool-call route cannot observe.
The live test becomes part of default CI or depends on non-local services.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd live_http_tools_call --locked
cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd --test live_http_tools_call --locked -- --ignored live_
humanEscalation: Approval before making live tests part of default CI
nextAction: Integrated locally; next HTTP live slice should cover remaining mutation endpoints only after retention and recovery policies stabilize.
